comment: Photo-scanned obstacles of the field of a battle, CC0, from Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com/license), as the developer asked on 2026-11-13 for obstacles that are real and textured and light. fetch_battle_models.ps1 downloads each as glTF with its textures at the resolution below to Saved/ModelSources/battle/<id>, blender_build_obstacles.py reduces it to about the triangles of its line and writes Saved/BattleObstacles/<Name>.glb, and import_battle_obstacles.py imports it to /Game/HexPlanet/Battle/Obstacles. The ground is where it stands: open (grass and the like), rocky (the letters of RockyGroundLetters, sand) or cave (the underground).
